name: Ormer Ironbraid
summary: Ormer Ironbraid is a dwarven archaeologist stationed at Whelgar's Excavation Site in the southern Wetlands. His team's historical research has been violently interrupted by ravenous raptors that overran the dig. Ormer seeks adventurous allies to clear out the beasts and avenge the miners driven from the site.

sections.title: A Dig Derailed
sections.body: Ormer Ironbraid arrived in the Wetlands as part of the dwarven effort to uncover Titan relics and ancient history at Whelgar's Excavation Site. Unfortunately, uncovering ancient stones also unearthed—or at least provoked—packs of fierce Wetlands raptors. Rather than cataloging ancient earthenware and tablets, Ormer spends his days watching the beasts prowl among the ruins, nursing a fierce hatred for the creatures that disrupted their work.

sections.title: A Bitter Feud with Claws
sections.body: Ormer refuses to abandon the dig, but he lacks the raw muscle to purge the site alone. He directs his frustration into a systematic campaign of extermination, enlisting passing travelers to slay raptors of increasing size and ferocity. For Ormer, reclaiming the excavation is not just about the artifacts—it is a deeply personal matter of dwarven pride and vengeance against the local wildlife.

faq.answer: Ormer Ironbraid is a dwarven researcher overseeing work at Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands. He represents the Explorers' League's interests in studying the ancient ruins buried in the marsh.

faq.q: Where can I find Ormer Ironbraid?
faq.answer: He can be found standing on the overlook above Whelgar's Excavation Site, located in the southern cliffs of the Wetlands, just east of the main road heading toward Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why does Ormer hate raptors so much?
faq.answer: The local raptor packs overran the excavation site, driving out the dwarven workers and halting all archaeological progress. Ormer took the disruption as a personal insult and seeks total payback.

It is an archaeological dig site founded by Ironforge dwarves to unearth ancient Titan and earthen ruins beneath the Wetlands. However, aggressive wildlife has turned the dig into a dangerous battleground.
Ormer offers the three-part 'Ormer's Revenge' quest chain, tasking adventurers with culling ever-larger raptors in the excavation site.

faq.q: Is Ormer affiliated with the Explorers' League?
faq.answer: Yes. Like many dwarves excavating ancient ruins across Khaz Modan, Ormer operates on behalf of the Ironforge archaeological efforts dedicated to uncovering their race's Titan heritage.

angles.text: Ormer embodies dwarven tenacity—refusing to yield ancient ancestral grounds to a pack of overgrown lizards.
Assisting Ormer secures the southern Wetlands road and aids Ironforge's vital archaeological endeavors.
Hunters will find Ormer's request a familiar task, pitting their tracking and beast-slaying prowess against some of the fiercest raptors in Khaz Modan.
